name: Chilly Dingo 79
author: roufkp
description: Outlined rounded dark amber button that lifts and glows on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, box-shadow becomes inset 0px 0px 0px 0px rgb(2 184 72), background changes from transparent to #211e18, transform becomes translateY(-5px).
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Chilly Dingo 79</title>
<style>
/* Chilly Dingo 79 by roufkp — https://uiverse.io/roufkp/chilly-dingo-79 */
.button {
  width: fit-content;
  padding: 12px 28px;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: .1rem;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  box-shadow: inset -20px -16px 0px 2px rgb(2 184 72);
  border-radius: 100px;
  color: rgb(67, 46, 19);
  transition: all 1s cubic-bezier(.66, .00, .34, 1.00);
}

button:hover {
  box-shadow: inset 0px 0px 0px 0px rgb(2 184 72);
  background: rgb(33, 30, 24);
  transform: translateY(-5px);
  color: rgb(230, 221, 221);
  font-weight: 700;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button">
  Button
</button>

</body>
</html>
